digest.component_or_area: Jira binding store and issue resolution
propositions: When a Jira issue moves between projects its KEY changes but numeric ID remains immutable; bindings keyed on KEY can become orphaned if the moved_issue_key table is not updated by third-party automation, causing the old key to stop resolving entirely

The binding store must capture and record the numeric jira_id alongside the key on every binding so that when a key lookup fails the resolution can be retried by the immutable numeric id and the binding can be re-keyed to the issue's current key
The absence probe must not retire an issue that is still reachable by its recorded numeric id, preventing silent detachment of live issues

On a Jira Data Center 8.17.1 instance a stale key after a project key rename returns HTTP 200 with the new key in the response body so the old key resolves transparently through the moved_issue_key table
A binding created before this fix has no recorded jira_id and must continue to function unchanged with no migration required while opportunistically capturing the id on the next successful read
